title: EventBus selective callback unregister cross-owner preservation contract

contract.cross_owner_selective_unregister: Unregister removes only the specified plugin/callback ownership entry
contract.same_owner_isolation: Removing one callback does not remove another callback owned by the same plugin
contract.cross_owner_isolation: Removing one owner's callback does not remove another owner's identical callback
contract.removed_entry_absence: The specified ownership entry is absent after unregister
contract.registry_stability: Selective cross-owner callback removal preserves registry integrity
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful after selective cross-owner unregister
contract.permission_enforcement: Register, unregister, and emit operations require the events permission
